freeze_reason: Protocol section 8B requires the same-momentum stochastic KL ablation. Add this omitted comparator before final selection and held-out execution, without changing the frozen base tuning grid or selecting extra parameters.
parameter_rule: Inherit selected stochastic-KL eta, eta-power, inner tolerance and all other solver settings; add selected smoothing rho0 with fixed beta=0.5. No additional tuning or held-out parameter selection.
momentum_convention: d0=g0 at product or matched randomized P0; reuse initial gradient for the first step; subsequent d_k=(1-rho_k)d_(k-1)+rho_k*g_k with rho_k=rho0*(k+1)^(-1/2); smooth gradient only, no marginal penalty.
matching: Clone every selected stochastic-KL base run cell: same instance and array hashes, stochastic seed, initialization seed and mode, precision policy, nominal solver budget and checkpoint opportunities. Only add momentum and change method/run identity.
candidate_id: kl_cXX_rho_cYY identifies inherited KL and smoothing candidates; it is not a separately tuned configuration.
selection_gate: Require the complete authoritative base selection, exact base-campaign/tuning/selection hashes, selected eligible candidate audit records, and already-frozen base final manifests before creating supplemental manifests. Never read held-out arrays here.
budget_note: Additional nominal solver budget only; initialization/iteration overshoot, diagnostics and other overhead are recorded separately. No base candidate or final budget is changed.
